stem.text: P and R are coplanar vectors.

stem.alt: Vectors P and R drawn from a common starting point: P points horizontally to the right, R points down and to the right. Labels P and R.

stem.text: If X = P – R, which diagram best represents vector X?

A.alt: Three arrows labelled X, R and P joined head to tail to form a triangle.

B.alt: Three arrows labelled X, R and P joined head to tail to form a triangle.

C.alt: Three arrows labelled P, R and X drawn from a common starting point.

D.alt: Three arrows labelled P, R and X drawn from a common starting point.
